About the CicloRecreoVía Santiago group ride

CicloRecreoVía Santiago is an open-streets program in Santiago, Chile: streets closed to cars and open to bikes. It runs every Sunday from 9:00 am local time.

Kilometers of car-free streets in Santiago every Sunday for walking, running, skating and cycling, about 35,000 people each week. The route changes by area: Centro-Oriente, Sur-Poniente and Oriente.
